title: Elements' significant hazards outside the US, rebuilt from GDACS and USGS PAGER
description: One row per hazard per country: GDACS events alerted orange or red, and USGS earthquakes of M4.5+ with a PAGER alert of yellow or higher, as Elements would have carried them (tier anomaly). For replaying triage's natural reading.

sources.name: GDACS event list (European Commission JRC and UN OCHA)
sources.licence: GDACS data free to use with attribution (gdacs.org terms of use)
sources.attribution: GDACS, European Commission Joint Research Centre and UN OCHA

sources.name: USGS earthquake catalog (FDSN event service), PAGER alerts

differences: GDACS's list gives each event's alert level as it stands now, not as it stood on each day: an event raised to orange late counts from its start.
Elements reads GDACS and USGS live every 2 hours; an event GDACS or USGS revised or deleted since is as it stands now.
Earthquakes are placed by the kit's thinned Natural Earth outlines (point in polygon), not by Elements' own place lookup.
NWS, SPC, USGS volcano, MeteoAlarm, tsunami, CEMS and EMSC items are not rebuilt.

gaps.reason: MeteoAlarm red warnings have no public archive
NWS Extreme alerts, SPC level 4-5 outlooks and USGS volcano alerts not rebuilt
tsunami messages not rebuilt (most follow a PAGER-alerted earthquake, which is)

biases: Low in Europe and the US, where Elements' other sources make most significant hazards.
GDACS alert levels are the latest, so a hazard that peaked later is counted early.

row_schema.place: ISO alpha-2 of a country the hazard names or lies in or near (null: unplaced)
row_schema.source_ref: the query URL that returned it
row_schema.item_id: the Elements item id it would have had
row_schema.hazard_code: EQ, TC, FL, VO, DR, WF
row_schema.to: GDACS event end (episodic TC and FL count while active)
row_schema.km_from_country: 0 inside; else km to the outline
row_schema.name: title

uses: replaying triage's natural reading outside the US for 2025
base rates of significant hazards per country-day
not_for: US or European hazard rates (gaps above)
a record of GDACS alert levels by day
